evidence.quote: I propose we each set a $300 blended rate for Quarter 1 and hold to it rather than undercut one another.
coordinating prices among competitors is a high-risk antitrust facilitation activity.
We should not coordinate rates or allocations; I’m happy to discuss other appropriate panel matters.

summary: Arden & Cole proposed a common $300 rate in Quarter 1 and asked the firms not to undercut one another. The other firms refused, and subsequent messages consistently affirmed independent rate-setting; no agreement was reached.
